How we do resistance training at Club Pilates. Swipe.
Resistance training means working against a load: springs, straps or your own body weight. Add a little more over time and your muscles adapt.
It's the strength that gets you up the stairs, carries the shopping and keeps you doing what you love.

slides.h: Standing work, with something steady to hold.
body: Our barre classes work your legs, glutes and balance with your feet on the floor and a hand on the barre. Small movements, plenty of burn, no wobbling.
TRX suspension straps use your own body weight, so you control the load by changing your angle. Our circuit-style classes move you between stations for full-body strength.
Some studios add load by having you stand on a moving reformer carriage. It looks impressive, but half your effort goes into staying upright.
We'd rather you lift from solid ground. Good form, more load when you're ready, and strength you'll use in real life. We think it's a safer, truer way to resistance train.
